notifications.name: LED Decorative Lights
notifications.danger: The wire at the point of connection of the LED elements is not resistant enough, leaving live parts accessible if subjected to mechanical stress. The user could touch the accessible live parts and receive an electric shock. This also creates a fire hazard. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive nor with the European standards EN 60598-1 and EN 60335-2-20.

notifications.description: Lighting chain with 400 LED lamps and a length of 50m. Power: 24W. Product sold online, in particular via euroled.lv.

notifications.name: TAPPETINO PER AUTO
notifications.danger: The product contains mercury (measured value: 0.029 mg/kg). Mercury bio-accumulates, is one of the most hazardous toxicants to the environment and is, through it, a threat to human health.Additionally, the product has an excessive concentration of copper and several phthalates, in particular dibutyl phthalate (DBP) (measured values: 1.97% and 39.4 % by weight respectively). Copper can cause liver and kidney damage and might affect fertility. DBP may harm the health by causing possible damage to the reproductive system. The product does not comply with the REACH Regulation.

notifications.name: Wall socket
notifications.danger: The breakdown isolation between the input and output circuits and the creepage and clearance distances between circuits of the wall socket are insufficient. Moreover there is no overcurrent protection device fitted to the USB input circuit. This can lead to overheating of the wall socket and cause a fire. The product does not comply with the requirements of the Low Voltage Directive, nor with the European standard EN 62368-1.

notifications.product: Vehicle part / Sideshaft, constant velocity joint
notifications.danger: The drive shafts and associated joints can break, which can result in a loss of drive, loss of steering, and/or failure of the parking function. An unexpected loss of driving force or steering while driving can increase the risk of accidents and injuries. Moreover, the vehicle may move after the gear shift lever is placed in 'Park,' if the CV joint in the side shaft tears or breaks during operation. This movement of the vehicle can further increase the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
